header.announcement: Official recruitment portal of Pakistan Railways

footer.about: Search current Pakistan Railways vacancies and apply online with one profile that stays with you.
footer.step1: Create your account with your CNIC and mobile number.
footer.step2: Fill in your profile once. Reuse it for every job.
footer.step3: Apply, then track your application here.

hero.title: Build your career with Pakistan Railways
hero.lead: One profile for every job. Create it once with your CNIC, and each application only asks for what's missing.

jobs.searchPlaceholder: Search jobs by title, keyword, BPS or department…
jobs.emptyDescription: Try different keywords or remove some filters.

job.applyNote: You'll only be asked for details that aren't already in your profile.
job.closedBody: The deadline for this job has passed.

req.educationWithMarks: {level} or higher, with at least {marks}% marks
req.ageNote: Age is worked out from your date of birth on the closing date.

fields.cnicHint: 13 digits, as printed on your CNIC
fields.mobileHint: We'll send a one-time code to this number

validation.captcha: Please confirm you're not a robot.
validation.dobFuture: Date of birth can't be in the future.
validation.year: Enter a year between 1950 and this year.
validation.endBeforeStart: End date must be after the start date.
validation.confirmRequired: Please tick this box to continue.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Your account comes with one permanent profile linked to your CNIC. You'll use it for every job you apply to.
signup.captchaNote: (A CAPTCHA check will replace this box.)
signup.permanentNote: You can only create one account per CNIC.

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Enter the CNIC and mobile number you signed up with.
login.mobileHint: The number registered with your account

profile.title: Your profile
profile.lead: One profile for every application. Changes here never alter applications you've already submitted.
profile.cnicFixed: Linked to your account and can't be changed.
profile.ageNote: You never enter your age. It's calculated from your date of birth for each job.
profile.sameAddress: Permanent address is the same as current address

education.empty: You haven't added any qualifications yet.
education.marksHint: For CGPA, enter the percentage shown on your transcript.

experience.lead: Add jobs you've held. Some posts need a minimum number of years.

profile.skillsLead: Add only skills and licences that matter for the jobs you want, e.g. a driving licence or typing speed.
profile.documentsLead: Upload each document once. We attach the right ones to each application. PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB.
profile.additionalLead: Tick what applies to you. These can affect quotas and the documents a job asks for.

additional.governmentEmployeeNote: You'll need to upload a no-objection certificate (NOC).
additional.disabilityNote: Upload your disability certificate to apply under the disability quota.
additional.minority: I belong to a religious minority
additional.minorityNote: You may apply under the minority quota where available.

profile.returnTitle: You were applying for a job
profile.returnBody: Save your changes, then go back to your application.

check.title: Check your eligibility
check.lead: We've compared this job's requirements with your profile. Fill in anything missing. It's saved to your profile for next time.

detail.educationLow: your highest qualification is below the requirement
detail.marksLow: your marks are below the minimum
detail.age: you'll be {count} on the closing date
detail.domicileOther: this job is only open to the domicile shown

check.notEligibleTitle: You're not eligible for this job
check.notEligibleBody: One or more requirements can't be met with your current details. If something is wrong, correct it in your profile.
check.alreadyApplied: You've already applied for this job.
check.continueHint: Complete the missing items above to continue.

review.title: Review and submit
review.lead: Check everything below. To change something, edit it in your profile and come back.
review.feeNote: Payment options (online or bank challan) will be added here.
review.confirmEligibility: I confirm that I meet all the eligibility requirements for this job.
review.confirmDeclaration: I declare that the information and documents I've provided are true and complete. I understand that false information can lead to rejection at any stage.
review.finalBody: After you submit, you can't edit or withdraw this application.

applications.title: My applications
applications.emptyDescription: When you apply for a job, you can follow its progress here.

tracking.title: Application {id}
tracking.submittedBody: Your application ID is {id}. Keep it for your records. We'll let you know when the status changes.
tracking.finalNote: Submitted applications are final and can't be edited or withdrawn.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.crashTitle: Something went wrong on this page
errors.crashBody: Reload the page to try again. If it keeps happening, please let us know.
errors.network_error: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.cnic_taken: An account with this CNIC already exists. Log in instead.
errors.account_not_found: No account matches this CNIC and mobile number.
errors.invalid_otp: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: Only PDF, JPG or PNG files can be uploaded.
errors.file_too_large: This file is larger than 2 MB. Please upload a smaller file.
errors.job_closed: Applications for this job have closed.
errors.already_applied: You've already applied for this job.
errors.declaration_required: Please accept the declaration to submit.
errors.requirements_incomplete: Some requirements are still missing. Go back to the eligibility check.
